overview_description.description: INZOX software development company that offers solutions to connect freelancers and businesses through an online platform. Its first product, HOURS, is a way to buy and sell services by the hour, providing to both freelancers and businesses. With HOURS, freelancers can showcase their skills and find work with businesses in need of their services. Meanwhile, businesses can find skilled freelancers for their projects, without having to commit to long-term contracts.
